options: Atomic hydrogen is more reactive due to its higher energy level.
Atomic hydrogen exists as a single atom, making it more available for reactions.
Molecular hydrogen has a stronger H-H bond, making it less reactive.
Molecular hydrogen forms a stable diatomic molecule.
questions.solution:
Correct Option is : (D)
Molecular hydrogen forms a stable diatomic molecule.
